observations.text: Re-review at clean HEAD ac9cd2a, scope limited to the corrected finding and the save-door obligation. The selection since the slice base is otherwise as recorded before: argv `git diff --name-only 701c6e7 ac9cd2a -- crates/foundry-acceptance/` yields the declared oracle feature file and three of the four declared supports; external_integration_plugins.rs is still unchanged and no undeclared test file changed.

Tree state and reuse, recorded at this commit rather than restamped: argv `git status --porcelain` exit 0 shows only `?? docs/feature/iis-setup-links/.nwdes-drafts/`, my own draft; `git rev-parse HEAD` exit 0 gives ac9cd2aae51a0c0678a80a3f0a5ad9c93523cf35. The run I rely on is the host-supplied lane us-iis-04 at /Users/jeffbailey/.cache/nwdes/iis-setup-links/s1-red-2.txt, executed by the acceptance designer in Lima VM foundry-test on the working tree that became ac9cd2a; its bytes are the bytes under review, which the output itself establishes: the only test-side change since 722c350 is page_in_front_of in integrations_wayfinding.rs, and the new output shows exactly its effect, both save examples reading the links off a 422-answered page that the previous reader refused. My own earlier run evidence at 722c350 (s1-red.txt) is cited only as the superseded state that produced the finding, not re-presented as a new execution; the eight link-list failures it recorded are unchanged in the new run and need no re-derivation. I executed no lane myself: the earlier judgments were preserved and only the corrected delta was re-observed.

The new run is infrastructure-sound and reviewable: 15 scenarios (5 passed, 10 failed), 141 steps (131 passed, 10 failed), 0 parsing errors, 0 hook errors, every Given and When matched. argv `grep -c "Captured output: precondition" /Users/jeffbailey/.cache/nwdes/iis-setup-links/s1-red-2.txt` exit 0 prints 0, so not one failure is a precondition, import, fixture or path defect masquerading as RED.

All ten failures are now semantic RED for the missing offer, each comparing the whole offer against the population it names (every non-sidebar href on the body, in reading order). The two that were precondition aborts now read their page: the Slack save at /team/backend/project/identity-platform/integrations/routes (422, text/html, form re-rendered) failed with left ["How to set up Slack"] versus right ["How to set up Slack", "Set up integrations for this Foundry"], and the Matrix save with left [] versus right ["Set up integrations for this Foundry"]. The save door that promise P2 names, cited by the Tested rows for both route-form outlines, therefore has a constructible falsifier at last: a wrong, missing or misordered I-19 on that post now fails the row, and the three doors of one kind are compared word for word and link for link. The five passing scenarios remain the promised P5/P3 preservation rows.

The fix for my finding holds, verified in the bytes and not only in the run: integrations_wayfinding.rs gains page_in_front_of, which admits a successful answer or a 422 whose content type starts text/html with a non-empty body, and refuses a redirect with no page, the uniform not-found page and a failure, saying so in a WHAT/WHY/HOW message; it replaces answered() in all three readers, then_page_links, then_each_link_opens and then_following_lands. The discriminator my remediation required is preserved: looked-and-found-nothing stays distinct from never-looked, so the empty-offer rows for Lena and for the unreadable connection still cannot pass on an unread page. No shipped status, word or production byte was changed to make the oracle green, which is what the finding asked for. The two authority rows revised at --at 4 and --at 5 state the same fact in the acceptance record: the save refuses in place and the reader takes the re-rendered form as the page it is, so the row is decided by its offers and not by how the refusal is answered. Finding resolved; removed from this review.

Pinning the locked copy (P5 and I-19) is the promised observation, not a wording pin on incidental prose.

Retained from the first review and unaffected by the delta: the twelve Tested rows cover P1, P2, P3 and P5 with a constructible stimulus, a whole-offer observation naming its population, and an explicit falsifier per row; the followed I-19 is pinned to /admin/instance/integrations by then_following_lands and the shipped guard scenario refuses every other viewer; each viewer fact is falsified independently (Priya with both facts, Lena as instance admin only, Lena as neither, Tomas as workspace admin only), so examiner expectation E6's route-form half adds no distinct observation beyond those rows and the declared NotTested exhaustive words table (owner crafter, command cargo test -p foundry-app --lib integrations::no_connection) with its stated preservation argument; examiner expectation E3 is preserved by shipped scenarios the slice does not touch (external-integration-plugins-01-connect-slack.feature:38/48, -01-signed-out.feature:39, -03-route-lifecycle.feature:107, instance-integration-setup.feature:62/278/312/398/442).

diagnostic: Accepted. The single blocking finding of the previous round is resolved in the bytes and in the run: page_in_front_of admits the save door's shipped 422-with-form refusal as the page it is while still refusing a redirect with no page, the not-found page and a failure, so the save door now compares link lists and an empty offer cannot be confused with an unread page; no shipped status, word or production byte was changed to achieve it, and the two acceptance rows say the same thing. All ten failures of the recorded lane are now semantic RED for the missing offer, with zero precondition, parsing and hook errors, and the five passes are the promised P5/P3 preservation rows. On that basis the oracle closes both directions of the completeness relation for S1: every obligation of P1, P2, P3 and P5 has at least one constructible falsifier through the public driving ports (the workspace integrations page, the route form GET and its preview and save posts, the project page and the followed links), and every observation traces to a declared promise, with the per-viewer rows falsifying each viewer fact independently, the whole-offer assertions naming the population they read, the locked copy pinned against the shipped constants, and the one declared NotTested obligation carrying its owner, command and preservation argument. Craft may start. Preserved as completion obligations: implementation GREEN of the ten red scenarios, the promised live observations, the declared verification commands (the foundry-app no_connection library check, the us-iis-04 and integrations-wayfinding lanes and cargo xtask check-arch), and the continued green state of the untouched shipped scenarios that keep US-IW-02 AC 1 valid. Capability limit retained: typesafe: unavailable (TYPESAFE_API_KEY absent, exit 3 re-checked at this commit), so every reviewer question was decided locally.
